title: Grok CLI product defaults (model, reasoning effort, plan pin)
description: Single source for the product default model id, reasoning-effort vocabulary, and --no-plan default pin. Python groklib.cli_defaults and Node scripts/lib/cli-defaults.mjs load this file. Do not retype these values in production code. grok-4.5 remains operator-selectable when named and listed by `grok models`; it is not required for preflight.
